name: lab-desk
description: The Lab desk, read-only: a live Hyperliquid chart your AI can see and paint on, a history lab (what happened after, moments like now, an honest test with fees, funding and a luck check), a watchlist above the prompt, price and funding in the status line, and the DaviddTech+ forecast range. No keys, no orders.

forecast.title: DaviddTech+ range on the chart
forecast.description: on asks DaviddTech+ for the coin's forecast once when you open a chart (one analyze_asset call, kept 6 hours) and draws its 50% and 80% ranges to the right of the candles; off never asks.

forecastHorizon.title: DaviddTech+ forecast length
forecastHorizon.description: How many days ahead the forecast range reaches: 5 or 20.

palette.title: Chart colors
palette.description: classic draws up candles teal and down candles red. colorblind draws up candles blue and down candles orange, a pair that stays apart for red-green color blindness and in grayscale.
